She is able to walk 1 to 1.5 miles daily. Physical therapy for her right knee has been beneficial and she has regained strength. She continues to experience episodes with morning vomiting and denies this is reflux into the throat but actual vomiting. She also reports abdominal pain and bloating. Last bowel movement was 2 days ago and was normal without blood. Denies diarrhea, weight loss, fever, or chills.
